title: File 47
description:
File 47 is not just a game; it’s a window into a shattered mind, an endless echo of a memory that should never have been.

In this disturbing psychological survival horror, you will descend into a nightmare that defies logic and reality. A labyrinth of fragmented memories, endless hallways that transform, and shadows that shouldn’t be there. Every decision matters, every corner hides a secret, and every step could be your last.

The past cannot be buried, but can you face it? Unravel the dark mysteries of a trauma marked by violence, explore the deepest recesses of the human mind, and search for answers in a world that refuses to give them up.

Every experience in File 47 is unique and random, with events and environments that change with each playthrough. But be careful: after midnight, the game shifts, becoming even more disturbing and pushing the limits of your sanity.

The real question is not what you’ll find at the end, but what you’ll lose along the way.

Are you ready to open the file?
description_short: A forgotten file. An echo that repeats. Memories that aren’t yours. The past always finds a way back. Are you ready to remember?
